authority_rule: These records translate approved dossier reading material into bounded Scryfall discovery threads. They do not replace, strengthen, or rewrite certified identity semantics, and they do not rank cards or commanders.

mechanical_threads.label: Taxes or visible restrictions
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find cards that increase an opponent's spell costs or explicitly limit an opponent's attacking or casting.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:"spells your opponents cast cost" OR o:"creatures your opponents control can't attack" OR o:"your opponents can't cast" OR o:"can't attack you")

mechanical_threads.label: Permission and counterspells
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find cards whose function is countering a spell before it resolves.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: otag:counterspell

mechanical_threads.label: Timed enforcement
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Addendum, board-wide resets, or effects whose casting and attack restrictions apply during a declared turn or main phase.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:addendum OR otag:board-wipe OR ((o:"during your turn" OR o:"during your main phase") AND (o:cast OR o:attack OR o:spell)))

mechanical_threads.label: Hand inspection or top-library reconnaissance
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find cards that inspect a hand or the top of a library before acting.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:"look at target player's hand" OR o:"look at the top")

mechanical_threads.label: Surveil filtering
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find cards with Surveil that filter the next draw and stock the graveyard.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: kw:surveil

mechanical_threads.label: Evasion or selective theft
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find threats whose evasion connects to attacking or combat damage, or effects that take control of another card.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: ((o:"can't be blocked" AND (o:"combat damage" OR o:attacks)) OR o:"gain control of target")

mechanical_threads.label: Spectacle or life-loss pressure
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Spectacle cards or effects that care whether an opponent lost life.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (kw:spectacle OR o:"lost life")

mechanical_threads.label: Life, discarded cards, or sacrificed bodies as costs
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find effects that pay life for a resource, discard to draw or cast, or sacrifice a creature for cards or damage.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: ((o:"pay life" AND (o:draw OR o:add OR o:cast)) OR (o:discard AND (o:draw OR o:cast OR o:graveyard)) OR (o:"sacrifice a creature" AND (o:draw OR o:damage)))

mechanical_threads.label: Sacrifice with a consequence
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find sacrifice outlets, death triggers, or creature sacrifices explicitly joined to cards, damage, or life loss.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (otag:sacrifice-outlet OR otag:death-trigger OR (o:"sacrifice a creature" AND (o:draw OR o:damage OR o:"lose life")))

mechanical_threads.label: Ramp into creature pressure
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find ramp that helps a creature-heavy plan claim the board quickly.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (otag:ramp OR (t:creature o:"add mana"))

mechanical_threads.label: Attack rewards or trample payoffs
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find attack triggers or trample joined to combat damage and visible creature growth.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:"whenever you attack" OR (kw:trample AND (o:"combat damage" OR o:"+1/+1 counter")))

mechanical_threads.label: Riot or haste-and-growth momentum
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Riot itself or effects that visibly join haste with +1/+1 counter growth.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (kw:riot OR (o:haste AND o:"+1/+1 counter"))

mechanical_threads.label: Convoke or creatures supplying mana
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Convoke itself or creature-board text that lets creatures supply mana for the next spell.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (kw:convoke OR (o:"creatures you control have" AND o:add AND o:mana))

mechanical_threads.label: Tokens with shared protection
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find token-making alongside effects that protect or strengthen the whole creature board.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:token AND (o:indestructible OR o:hexproof OR o:"creatures you control get"))

mechanical_threads.label: Lifegain or anthem preservation
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find life gain or team-wide bonuses that preserve a shared board.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:"gain life" OR o:"creatures you control get")

mechanical_threads.label: Death triggers or obligation engines
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find death-trigger shells where a creature leaving creates the next payment or benefit.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (otag:death-trigger OR o:"whenever another creature dies")

mechanical_threads.label: Taxes or opponent drain
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find cards that raise a visible cost or explicitly make an opponent or each opponent lose life.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:"cost {1} more" OR ((o:"each opponent" OR o:"an opponent") AND (o:"lose life" OR o:"loses life")))

mechanical_threads.label: Afterlife or death-made Spirits
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Afterlife itself or death triggers that explicitly create Spirit creature tokens.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (kw:afterlife OR (o:dies AND o:"spirit creature token"))

mechanical_threads.label: Copy and adjust a spell
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find effects that copy an instant or sorcery as the experiment develops.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:copy AND (o:instant OR o:sorcery))

mechanical_threads.label: Jump-start or discarded spells recast
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Jump-start itself or discard and graveyard text joined to casting an instant or sorcery again.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (kw:jump-start OR (o:discard AND o:graveyard AND o:cast AND (o:instant OR o:sorcery)))

commander.rationale: The governed local corpus has no exact blue-red commander with Jump-start or text that discards and recasts an instant or sorcery from the graveyard. The support and stretch projections remain available.

mechanical_threads.label: Overload or one effect scaled across targets
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Overload itself or instant, sorcery, or spell text that expands one targeted effect across each valid target.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (kw:overload OR (o:each AND o:target AND (o:instant OR o:sorcery OR o:spell)))

mechanical_threads.label: Trade, then reclaim
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find cards that return spent permanents or creatures from the graveyard.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:return AND o:graveyard)

mechanical_threads.label: Death and graveyard resource loops
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find cards that connect dying or sacrifice to later graveyard value.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: ((o:dies OR o:sacrifice) AND o:graveyard)

mechanical_threads.label: Undergrowth or graveyard counts
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Undergrowth or cards that count creature cards in a graveyard.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (kw:undergrowth OR o:"creature cards in your graveyard")

mechanical_threads.label: Creature-led ramp and card flow
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find creatures that produce mana or turn creature growth into cards.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (t:creature AND (o:"add mana" OR o:draw))

mechanical_threads.label: Evolve, Graft, Adapt, or counters
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find biological growth mechanics or +1/+1 counter text.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (kw:evolve OR kw:graft OR kw:adapt OR o:"+1/+1 counter")

mechanical_threads.label: Proliferate or responsive upgrades
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Proliferate or effects that add counters as the board changes.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (kw:proliferate OR o:"put a +1/+1 counter")

mechanical_threads.label: Battalion or coordinated attack rewards
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Battalion, three-creature attack thresholds, or attack triggers that explicitly create or improve attacking creatures.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (kw:battalion OR o:"three or more creatures attack" OR (o:"whenever you attack" AND o:"attacking creature"))

mechanical_threads.label: Mentor the front line
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Mentor cards that let an established attacker grow another creature.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: kw:mentor

mechanical_threads.label: Equipment with protection
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Equipment or attachment text paired with protection, indestructible, or ward.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: ((t:equipment OR o:attach) AND (o:protection OR o:indestructible OR o:ward))

mechanical_threads.label: Cards leaving graveyards
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find cards that explicitly trigger when a card leaves a graveyard.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:"leaves your graveyard" OR o:"leave your graveyard")

mechanical_threads.label: Sacrifice and recover artifacts
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find cards that mention artifacts and join sacrifice to graveyard return, recovery, or copying.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:artifact AND o:sacrifice AND (o:return OR o:graveyard OR o:copy))

mechanical_threads.label: Attack into a spell
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find attack triggers that cast, copy, or reveal an instant or sorcery.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:attack AND (o:instant OR o:sorcery) AND (o:cast OR o:copy OR o:reveal))

mechanical_threads.label: Elemental performance
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Elementals that keep the spell's elemental medium present on the board.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: t:elemental

mechanical_threads.label: Large spells and copied sequences
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find high-mana-value instants or sorceries and effects that copy them.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: ((t:instant OR t:sorcery) AND (mv>=6 OR o:copy))

mechanical_threads.label: Copy or protect the chosen spell
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find spell-copying, counterspells, or spells that explicitly cannot be countered.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: ((o:copy AND (o:instant OR o:sorcery OR o:spell)) OR otag:counterspell OR o:"can't be countered")

mechanical_threads.label: Pests moving life into value
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Pests connected to life gain, life loss, or sacrifice rather than a generic death mention.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: ((t:pest OR o:pest) AND (o:"gain life" OR o:"lose life" OR o:sacrifice))

stretch.rationale: The governed local corpus has no commander outside Black-Green that joins Pest text to life exchange or sacrifice. The exact-identity commander and support projections remain available.

mechanical_threads.label: Life moved through sacrifice
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find cards that join life gain or life loss with sacrificing a creature or permanent.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: ((o:"gain life" OR o:"lose life" OR o:"loses life") AND o:sacrifice)

mechanical_threads.label: Bodies circulating through the graveyard
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find dying or graveyard text joined to return, tokens, or life gain.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: ((o:dies OR o:graveyard) AND (o:return OR o:token OR o:"gain life"))

mechanical_threads.label: Fractals or measured counters
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Fractals or creatures whose size is built with +1/+1 counters.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (t:fractal OR (t:creature AND o:"+1/+1 counter"))

mechanical_threads.label: Copy or double a board pattern
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find effects that copy a token, counter, or permanent, or double tokens, counters, or power.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: ((o:copy AND (o:token OR o:counter OR o:permanent)) OR (o:double AND (o:counter OR o:token OR o:power)))

mechanical_threads.label: X values or proportional scaling
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find cards whose output uses X, doubles, or scales for each counted object.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:"where X is" OR o:twice OR o:"for each")

mechanical_threads.label: Counters or Inklings
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find +1/+1 counter text or Inkling creature and token references.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:"+1/+1 counter" OR t:inkling OR o:inkling)

mechanical_threads.label: Attack incentives
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find cards that reward attacking or point combat toward a chosen opponent.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:"whenever you attack" OR o:"attacks target opponent")

mechanical_threads.label: Targeted creature or player leverage
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find creature targets joined to growth or removal, player targets joined to cards or life loss, or opponent targets joined to life loss, sacrifice, or combat.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: ((o:"target creature" AND (o:"+1/+1 counter" OR o:gets OR o:destroy OR o:exile)) OR (o:"target player" AND (o:draw OR o:discard OR o:"lose life")) OR (o:"target opponent" AND (o:"lose life" OR o:sacrifice OR o:attack)))

mechanical_threads.label: Tokens with shared protection
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find token text joined to team protection or bonuses, or indestructibility applied across creatures you control.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: ((o:token AND (o:indestructible OR o:"creatures you control get" OR o:"creatures you control have")) OR (o:indestructible AND o:"creatures you control"))

mechanical_threads.label: Taxes or rules
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find cards that increase an opponent's spell costs or explicitly limit an opponent's attacking or casting.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:"spells your opponents cast cost" OR o:"creatures your opponents control can't attack" OR o:"your opponents can't cast" OR o:"can't attack you")

mechanical_threads.label: Equipment or guardians
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Equipment or equip text that builds and protects a creature.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (t:equipment OR o:equip OR o:attach)

mechanical_threads.label: Card draw or counterspells
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find draw effects or cards whose function is countering a spell.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (otag:draw OR otag:counterspell)

mechanical_threads.label: Spells that create board pressure
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find instants or sorceries connected to token creation or cast triggers.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: ((t:instant OR t:sorcery OR o:"whenever you cast") AND o:token)

mechanical_threads.label: Artifact or permanent-copy engines
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find artifacts that copy, make token copies, or untap, or effects that copy an artifact or permanent.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: ((t:artifact AND (o:copy OR o:"create a token" OR o:untap)) OR (o:copy AND (o:artifact OR o:permanent)))

mechanical_threads.label: Life payment engines
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find cards that pay or lose life to draw cards or gain another resource.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: ((o:"pay life" OR o:"lose life") AND (o:draw OR o:add))

mechanical_threads.label: Sacrifice outlets or death rewards
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find sacrifice outlets, death triggers, or creature sacrifices explicitly joined to cards, damage, or life loss.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (otag:sacrifice-outlet OR otag:death-trigger OR (o:"sacrifice a creature" AND (o:draw OR o:damage OR o:"lose life")))

mechanical_threads.label: Return creatures from the graveyard
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find cards that return a creature card from a graveyard.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:return AND o:"creature card" AND o:graveyard)

mechanical_threads.label: Burn and direct damage
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find effects that explicitly deal damage to any target, a creature, a player, or each opponent.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:"deals damage" AND (o:"any target" OR o:"target creature" OR o:"target player" OR o:"each opponent"))

mechanical_threads.label: Haste or immediate attacks
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Haste cards or effects that reward attacking this turn.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (kw:haste OR o:"attacks this turn")

mechanical_threads.label: Impulse draw or Treasures
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find temporary top-card access or Treasure creation.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:"exile the top" OR o:treasure)

mechanical_threads.label: Ramp or land acceleration
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find cards with a ramp function or land-to-battlefield acceleration.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (otag:ramp OR (o:land AND o:battlefield))

mechanical_threads.label: Power-four creatures and trample
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find large creatures or creatures with trample.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (t:creature AND (pow>=4 OR kw:trample))

mechanical_threads.label: Landfall or creature-land card flow
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Landfall or creature-and-land text connected to drawing cards.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (kw:landfall OR (o:land AND o:creature AND o:draw))

mechanical_threads.label: Exalted or attacks alone
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Exalted or effects that reward one creature attacking alone.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (kw:exalted OR o:"attacks alone")

mechanical_threads.label: Creature entries, blink, and Clues
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find creature-led entry value, blink text, or Clue creation.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (t:creature AND (o:enters OR o:clue OR (o:exile AND o:return)))

mechanical_threads.label: Enchantments, Auras, or Equipment
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find enchantment, Aura, or Equipment cards for a supported creature plan.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (t:enchantment OR t:aura OR t:equipment)

mechanical_threads.label: Counterspells or board resets
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find counterspells or board-wide removal that narrows the table's options.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (otag:counterspell OR otag:board-wipe)

mechanical_threads.label: Draw, filtering, or library planning
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find card draw or effects that inspect and arrange the top of a library.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (otag:draw OR o:"look at the top" OR o:"put them back")

mechanical_threads.label: Artifact value engines
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find artifacts that draw, accumulate counters, sacrifice, untap, or reuse artifacts from the graveyard.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (t:artifact AND (o:draw OR o:counter OR o:sacrifice OR o:untap OR (o:artifact AND o:graveyard)))

mechanical_threads.label: Counterspells or creature removal
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find counterspells or text that destroys a target creature.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (otag:counterspell OR o:"destroy target creature")

mechanical_threads.label: Life, cards, or bodies converted into leverage
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find paying life for resources, discarding into cards, casting, or graveyard use, or sacrificing a creature for cards, damage, or graveyard value.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: ((o:"pay life" AND (o:draw OR o:add OR o:cast)) OR (o:discard AND (o:draw OR o:cast OR o:graveyard)) OR (o:"sacrifice a creature" AND (o:draw OR o:damage OR o:graveyard)))

mechanical_threads.label: Direct damage or table-wide life loss
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find explicit damage to a target or each opponent, or effects that make each opponent lose life.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: ((o:"deals damage" AND (o:"any target" OR o:"each opponent" OR o:"target player")) OR (o:"each opponent" AND o:"lose life"))

mechanical_threads.label: Haste or attack pressure
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Haste or attack-trigger text that forces an immediate answer.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (kw:haste OR o:"whenever you attack")

mechanical_threads.label: Sacrifice consequences or graveyard returns
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find sacrifice joined to death, graveyard, or damage, or explicit graveyard return effects.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: ((o:sacrifice AND (o:dies OR o:graveyard OR o:damage)) OR (o:graveyard AND o:return))

mechanical_threads.label: Damage from spent resources
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find damage effects connected to a creature dying or a permanent being sacrificed.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:damage AND (o:dies OR o:sacrifice))

mechanical_threads.label: Ramp into a creature habitat
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find ramp or land development that supports a creature-heavy board.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (otag:ramp OR (o:land AND o:battlefield))

mechanical_threads.label: Protection for the bonded board
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find hexproof, indestructible, ward, or protection explicitly granted to creatures or permanents you control.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (((o:"creatures you control have" OR o:"permanents you control have") AND (o:hexproof OR o:indestructible OR o:ward OR o:protection)) OR (o:"target creature you control gains" AND (o:hexproof OR o:indestructible OR o:ward OR o:protection)))

commander.rationale: The governed local corpus has no exact Naya commander that explicitly grants hexproof, indestructible, ward, or protection to creatures or permanents you control. The support and stretch projections remain available.

mechanical_threads.label: Large creatures and combat scaling
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find power-four creatures or +1/+1 counter text that scales combat.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (t:creature AND (pow>=4 OR o:"+1/+1 counter"))

mechanical_threads.label: A durable creature board
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find creatures or effects that grant indestructible, regeneration, or shield counters.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (t:creature AND (o:indestructible OR o:regenerate OR o:"shield counter"))

mechanical_threads.label: Return the dead to duty
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find cards that return creatures or permanents from a graveyard.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:return AND o:graveyard)

mechanical_threads.label: Counters, lifegain, or recursion preserving a board
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find team or creature counters, life gain joined to counters or graveyard return, or explicit graveyard recursion.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: ((o:"+1/+1 counter" AND (o:"creatures you control" OR o:"target creature")) OR (o:"gain life" AND (o:counter OR o:return OR o:graveyard)) OR (o:return AND o:graveyard))

mechanical_threads.label: Power-four payoffs or Ferocious
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Ferocious or effects that explicitly care about power 4 or greater.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:ferocious OR o:"power 4 or greater" OR o:"power 4 or more")

commander.rationale: The governed local corpus has no exact Temur commander with Ferocious or an explicit power-four payoff. The support and stretch projections remain available.

mechanical_threads.label: Ramp into expensive threats
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find ramp or mana production that supports higher-mana-value threats and abilities.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (otag:ramp OR (o:"add mana" AND mv>=5))

mechanical_threads.label: Spells and copied effects
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find effects that copy instants, sorceries, or another spell.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:copy AND (o:instant OR o:sorcery OR o:spell))

records.intentional_exception: The optional Survival Through Attunement Vox Mana lens remains in the dossier but is not converted into a Scryfall mechanical thread; a card query cannot prove that interpretive lens.

mechanical_threads.label: Mill, discard, or sacrifice converted into value
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find mill joined to graveyard use, discard joined to cards, casting, or the graveyard, or sacrifice joined to cards, return, or the graveyard.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: ((o:mill AND o:graveyard) OR (o:discard AND (o:graveyard OR o:draw OR o:cast)) OR (o:sacrifice AND (o:graveyard OR o:return OR o:draw)))

mechanical_threads.label: Graveyard return and reuse
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find cards that return a card or permanent from a graveyard.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:return AND o:graveyard)

mechanical_threads.label: Tutors, theft, or counterspells
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find tutor functions, control-changing effects, or counterspells.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (otag:tutor OR o:"gain control" OR otag:counterspell)

commander.rationale: The governed local corpus has no exact Sultai commander that directly tutors, steals control, or counters a spell under the bounded query. The support and stretch projections remain available.

mechanical_threads.label: Raid or attack momentum
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Raid wording or effects that reward attacking this turn.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:raid OR o:"attacked this turn" OR o:"whenever you attack")

mechanical_threads.label: A coordinated attacking formation
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find effects that join creatures you control to attacking, or make a creature attacking multiply a triggered ability.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: ((o:"creatures you control" AND o:attack) OR (o:"creature attacking" AND o:trigger))

mechanical_threads.label: Sacrifice, Treasure, or impulse conversion
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find sacrifice joined to cards, damage, or Treasure; Treasure joined to sacrifice or impulse access; or exile-the-top effects that allow the card to be played.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: ((o:sacrifice AND (o:treasure OR o:draw OR o:damage)) OR (o:treasure AND (o:sacrifice OR o:"exile the top")) OR (o:"exile the top" AND o:"you may play"))

mechanical_threads.label: Counterspells or spell protection
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find counterspells or text that explicitly says the user's spells, instants, or sorceries cannot be countered.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (otag:counterspell OR o:"spells you control can't be countered" OR o:"instant and sorcery spells you control can't be countered")

commander.rationale: The governed local corpus has no exact Jeskai commander with a bounded counterspell or spell-protection clause. The support and stretch projections remain available.

mechanical_threads.label: Copy instants and sorceries
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find effects that copy an instant, sorcery, or spell.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:copy AND (o:instant OR o:sorcery OR o:spell))

mechanical_threads.label: Prowess or trained attacks
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Prowess or attack triggers tied to noncreature spell play.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (kw:prowess OR (o:attack AND o:"noncreature spell"))

mechanical_threads.label: Artifact engines and repeated activation
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find artifact cards that sacrifice, untap, copy, or explicitly govern repeated activation.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (t:artifact AND (o:sacrifice OR o:untap OR o:copy OR o:"activate only"))

mechanical_threads.label: Artifacts recovered from the graveyard
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find artifact cards that explicitly return, cast, or put artifact cards from a graveyard into use.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (t:artifact AND (((o:"artifact card" OR o:"artifacts") AND o:graveyard) AND (o:return OR o:cast OR o:put)))

commander.rationale: Breya is the only exact Yore commander in the governed local corpus, and her card does not recover or cast artifacts from a graveyard. The support projection remains available; the stretch intersection is separately unavailable.

stretch.rationale: The governed local corpus has no commander outside Yore whose card is itself an artifact and explicitly returns, casts, or puts artifact cards from a graveyard into use. The support projection remains available.

mechanical_threads.label: Artifacts spent to rebuild
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find artifact sacrifice or artifact-token text that converts one component into the next.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: ((t:artifact AND o:sacrifice) OR o:"artifact token")

mechanical_threads.label: Exiled cards or Treasures converted into momentum
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find exile that becomes temporary play or casting access, or Treasure joined to drawing, discarding, or sacrifice.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (((o:"you may play" OR o:"you may cast") AND o:exile) OR (o:treasure AND (o:draw OR o:discard OR o:sacrifice)))

stretch.query_clause: ((o:"exile the top" AND (o:"you may play" OR o:"you may cast")) OR (o:treasure AND (o:draw OR o:discard OR o:sacrifice)))
stretch.interpretation: Find commanders outside Glint that turn cards exiled from the top into temporary access, or join Treasures to drawing, discarding, or sacrifice.

mechanical_threads.label: Storm or copied spells
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Storm itself or effects that explicitly copy an instant, sorcery, or spell.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (kw:storm OR (o:copy AND (o:instant OR o:sorcery OR o:spell)))

commander.rationale: Yidris is the only exact Glint commander in the governed local corpus, and his card has neither Storm nor spell-copy text. The support and stretch projections remain available.

mechanical_threads.label: Sacrifice, combat damage, or attack conversion
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find sacrifice joined to cards, damage, or Treasure; combat damage joined to casting, cards, or exile; or attack triggers joined to exile, casting, or drawing.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: ((o:sacrifice AND (o:damage OR o:draw OR o:treasure)) OR (o:"combat damage" AND (o:cast OR o:draw OR o:exile)) OR (o:"whenever you attack" AND (o:exile OR o:cast OR o:draw)))

mechanical_threads.label: Attack rewards or combat-damage pressure
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find attack triggers joined to damage, counters, or tokens, or combat damage explicitly aimed at an opponent or the table.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: ((o:"whenever you attack" AND (o:damage OR o:"+1/+1 counter" OR o:token)) OR (o:"combat damage" AND (o:"target opponent" OR o:"each opponent" OR o:"chosen player")))

mechanical_threads.label: The whole creature line attacks
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find effects that explicitly refer to attacking creatures you control, creatures you control attacking, or combat damage dealt by a creature you control.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:"attacking creatures you control" OR o:"creatures you control attack" OR (o:"creature you control" AND o:"combat damage"))

stretch.query_clause: (o:"attacking creatures you control" OR o:"creatures you control attack")
stretch.interpretation: Find commanders outside Dune whose text explicitly treats the attacking creature line as a shared formation.

mechanical_threads.label: Token multiplication or repeated combat damage
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find token text joined to doubling, repetition, or counted multiplication, or combat damage that is dealt again to a chosen player.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: ((o:token AND (o:double OR o:twice OR o:"for each")) OR (o:"deals that much damage" AND o:"combat damage"))

mechanical_threads.label: Resources shared with each player
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find effects that explicitly let each player draw, gain life, add mana, or put a land onto the battlefield.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:"each player may draw" OR o:"each player draws" OR o:"each player gains life" OR o:"each player adds" OR (o:"each player may" AND o:"land card" AND o:battlefield))

mechanical_threads.label: Shared or table-wide card draw
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find effects that explicitly let each player draw, make each player draw, or give each opponent a card.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:"each player may draw" OR o:"each player draws" OR (o:"each opponent" AND o:"draws a card"))

mechanical_threads.label: Protection around shared value
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find each-player text on a card that also explicitly counters a spell or grants hexproof or indestructible to the user's creatures or permanents.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:"each player" AND (otag:counterspell OR o:"spells you control can't be countered" OR o:"permanents you control have hexproof" OR o:"permanents you control have indestructible" OR o:"creatures you control have hexproof" OR o:"creatures you control have indestructible"))

commander.rationale: The governed local corpus has no exact Ink commander that joins each-player shared value to bounded counterspell or board-protection text. The support projection remains available; the stretch intersection is separately unavailable.

stretch.rationale: The governed local corpus has no commander outside Ink whose card joins each-player text to bounded counterspell or board-protection text. The support projection remains available.

mechanical_threads.label: Counters growing through time or proliferate
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find +1/+1 counters connected to upkeep, end steps, or proliferation, or the Proliferate keyword itself.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: ((o:"+1/+1 counter" AND (o:upkeep OR o:"end step" OR o:proliferate)) OR kw:proliferate)

mechanical_threads.label: Ramp or calculated doubling
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find governed ramp effects or doubling explicitly applied to counters, mana, or tokens.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (otag:ramp OR (o:double AND (o:counter OR o:mana OR o:token)))

commander.rationale: The two exact Witch commanders in the governed local corpus do not ramp or double counters, mana, or tokens. The support and stretch projections remain available.

mechanical_threads.label: Protect the scaling engine
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find hexproof, indestructible, ward, or protection explicitly granted to creatures or permanents you control.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (((o:"creatures you control have" OR o:"permanents you control have") AND (o:hexproof OR o:indestructible OR o:ward OR o:protection)) OR (o:"target creature you control gains" AND (o:hexproof OR o:indestructible OR o:ward OR o:protection)))

commander.rationale: The two exact Witch commanders in the governed local corpus do not grant bounded protection to creatures or permanents you control. The support and stretch projections remain available.

mechanical_threads.label: True colorless mana
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find cards that produce or explicitly require true colorless mana.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (produces:c OR o:"{C}")

mechanical_threads.label: Artifact engines
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find artifacts that draw, make mana, untap, copy, accumulate counters, or turn sacrifice into repeatable value.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (t:artifact AND (o:draw OR o:add OR o:untap OR o:copy OR o:counter OR o:sacrifice))

mechanical_threads.label: Eldrazi or Devoid
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Eldrazi cards or cards with Devoid as a separate Colorless direction.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (t:eldrazi OR kw:devoid)

mechanical_threads.label: Five-Color toolbox access
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find tutor functions that help a commander-specific Five-Color plan assemble its chosen answers.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: otag:tutor

mechanical_threads.label: Five-Color typal reach
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find cards that choose a creature type or explicitly reward creatures of a chosen type across the color pie.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:"choose a creature type" OR o:"creatures of the chosen type" OR o:"creature type of your choice" OR o:"creatures you control of each type")

mechanical_threads.label: Rainbow or color-count payoffs
mechanical_threads.interpretation: Find Domain, Converge, Sunburst, all-five-symbol, or color-count wording.
mechanical_threads.query_clause: (o:domain OR o:converge OR o:sunburst OR o:"{W}{U}{B}{R}{G}" OR o:"among colors")

records.intentional_exception: There is no Commander color identity outside Five-Color. The Outside-color stretch lane is replaced by an explicit boundary explanation, and the optional Full-Spectrum Integrator remains dossier interpretation rather than a query claim.
